plugins.cameraPermission: Switchboard scans a QR code shown by the desktop app to pair with a backend.

plugins.microphonePermission: Switchboard uses the microphone so you can dictate prompts to your agents instead of typing them.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Switchboard transcribes your voice into the message composer.

plugins.photosPermission: Switchboard attaches screenshots and photos from your library to messages you send to an agent.

extra.//updates: OTA is live: `eas init` + `eas update:configure` were run on 2026-07-27 against EAS account tejasnafde, which wrote `updates.url` and `extra.eas.projectId` below. `runtimeVersion.policy: appVersion` pins each OTA bundle to a matching native binary, so a JS bundle can never be served to an APK missing native modules it needs. `REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES` is what lets the app hand a downloaded APK to Android's package installer (src/lib/selfUpdate.ts); CAMERA is for the pairing QR scanner; RECORD_AUDIO is for voice dictation in the chat composer (src/lib/voice.ts, needs the dev build - Expo Go hides the mic).
extra.//: Google OAuth client for the direct accounts.google.com PKCE flow (src/lib/google-auth.ts). Real values live in Secret Manager secret 'switchboard-oauth-client' in GCP project teejayproject: gcloud --configuration=personal secrets versions access latest --secret=switchboard-oauth-client. NEVER commit real values here. The stored client is Desktop-type, which works for the loopback probe but is REJECTED for custom-scheme redirects on device: shipping needs an Android-type client (package app.switchboard.mobile + signing SHA-1) and an iOS-type client. Those have no secret, so googleClientSecret stays empty for device builds.
